proof_body:
by
  intro a b c ha
  have ha' : a ≠ 0 := ha.ne'
  have key : ∀ x : ℝ, a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c = a * (x + b / (2 * a)) ^ 2 + (4 * a * c - b ^ 2) / (4 * a) := by
    intro x
    field_simp
    ring
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_Ici]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    have := mul_nonneg ha.le (sq_nonneg (x + b / (2 * a)))
    rw [key x]
    linarith
  · intro hy
    have hnn : 0 ≤ (y - (4 * a * c - b ^ 2) / (4 * a)) / a := div_nonneg (by linarith) ha.le
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hnn
    refine ⟨-(b / (2 * a)) + Real.sqrt ((y - (4 * a * c - b ^ 2) / (4 * a)) / a), ?_⟩
    rw [key]
    have e : -(b / (2 * a)) + Real.sqrt ((y - (4 * a * c - b ^ 2) / (4 * a)) / a) + b / (2 * a) = Real.sqrt ((y - (4 * a * c - b ^ 2) / (4 * a)) / a) := by ring
    rw [e, hs]
    field_simp
    ring
target_source: ∀ (a b c : ℝ), 0 < a → Set.range (fun x : ℝ => a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) = Set.Ici ((4 * a * c - b ^ 2) / (4 * a))
